name: How much does it cost to fix a leaky faucet in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a leaky faucet in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a leaky faucet in Berkeley varies depending on the type of faucet, the cause of the leak, and whether parts need to be replaced. Minor leaks might involve a simple washer replacement, while more complex issues could require new components or a full faucet replacement. We provide a detailed estimate after assessing the specific problem.
